added_lines: CAROLAN , Carnaross, (brother of Anne & Eileen Carney) Our ANNUAL REMEMBRANCE MASS will take place at 7pm this THURSDAY 26 NOVEMBER IN BEAUPARC CHURCH . During this Mass we will remember the parishioners whose funeral Mass took place i n Beauparc & Kentstown parish during the past year – Kathleen Byrne, Kathleen Bennett, Mary Keating, Carol Dixon, Tony Pain, Frances McKeever, Phil Smyth, Declan Wall, Bernie Crosse, Mary McDonnell, Kathleen Collier, Mary McGrath, Paddy Owens, Eamonn O’ Brien, Padraic Gilligan, Mary McCarthy, John Munnelly, Dolores Farr ell. The Mass will be followed by a cuppa & refreshments in the hall. THANK YOU TO OUR DECEASED BENEFACTORS who have been kind enough to remember our parish in their wills. PRAYER TO THE HOLY SPIRIT of God, grant me: the gift of WISDOM to see the world through your eyes, the gift of COUNSEL to make difficult decisions, the gifts of KNOWLEDGE and UNDERSTANDING to use my mind to know you and to love you, the gift of FORTITUDE to have the courage to live in the faith despite the difficulties and disappointments, the gift of PIETY to be able to express my special love and commitment to you, and the right kind of AWESOME FEAR that makes me pause to wonder and revere God’s love. Amen. SAINT JOSEPH'S YOUNG PRIEST SOCIETY EUCHARISTIC ADORATION FOR VOCATIONS TO THE PRIESTHOOD in Kentstown church this Sun 22 Nov from 3pm to 4pm . If you’ d like to become a member of Saint Joseph's Young Priest Society call Marie on 041 98 25 153 Join our PARISH WALK2W IN CHALLENGE . Each day we’ll randomly pick a distance between 1km & 5km which you must Walk (Jog or Run) in a single session before midnight of the following day. The distance to be completed each day will be posted on our Facebook page. If you are interested in entering the 50/50 version of this challenge for the month of December starting on Tues 1 Dec with a chance to win up to €250 contact Fr David for the terms & conditions. Entry for this is €10 but feel free to do the ordinary challenge on your own terms as the Wheel Spin will be posted on Facebook each day . Beauparc

. I. During November, we pray for our brothers and siste rs who have died that they have passed from death to life in the company of the Lord Jesus, who died and rose to new life.
We commend them to the Love and Mercy of God, Our Father.
We pray for those who mourn the death ofa loved one.
Lord of all gentleness, surround us with your care and comfort us in our sorrow.
It is our certain faith that your Son Jesus Christ, who died on the cross was raised from the dead.
Grant through this mystery, that all who have gone to their eternal rest in Christ may now share in the joy of His Resurrection . We ask this through Christ Our Lord.
